note: Two-state key manifest (spec §5.1). Every key observed in the Release Mirror's data files is either `mapped` — consumed by a note property, a body task, or the Run Report — or `ignored` with a rationale. Declaring a key in a template's CUE fence is not consumption, so a declared-but-unconsumed key is listed here as ignored. `presence: required` means the key must be observed at the pin; `presence: rare` means its absence is normal and its disappearance is only worth knowing.

community-plugins.json.role: Plugin Index — authoritative membership for plugins

id.target: plugin note filename, xid, first alias, uid name, Directory Page url, Plugin Stats join key

name.target: plugin note H1 and name alias

author.target: plugin data block `author` field. No frontmatter property carries it — authorship is reachable through the linked repository note — but since the Data Contract fence is filled rather than stripped (owner decision, 2026-08-06) the value is recorded in the note itself.

description.target: plugin body input (hashed; a change queues a body task) and the data block `description` field

repo.target: plugin repo alias, alt (GitHub address), repository resolution key

community-css-themes.json.role: Theme Index — authoritative membership for themes

name.target: theme note H1, name alias, slug derivation (filename, xid, uid name, url)

author.target: theme data block `author` field; as for plugins, no frontmatter property carries it.

repo.target: theme repo alias, alt, screenshot derivation, repository resolution key

screenshot.target: screenshot embed in the theme body and `screenshot_url` in the theme data block (URL-encoded, decision 3.9)

legacy.target: theme `legacy` property; false when the key is absent

community-plugin-stats.json.role: Plugin Stats — download totals and last-update timestamps keyed by plugin id

downloads.target: plugin `downloads` property and the data block `stats.downloads` field, raw integer

updated.target: plugin `updated at` property, epoch milliseconds converted to ISO 8601 UTC; the data block records the raw epoch integer as `stats.updated_at`

otherKeys.rationale: Per-release download counters. Per-version download series are out of catalog scope (§10), and their churn is an explicitly ignored Update Run event (§6.3.3). The key is the upstream GitHub release tag, not a version number: at the pin 75,020 of 75,052 such keys are semver-shaped with an optional `v` prefix and 32 are arbitrary tag names (`publish`, `build/main.js`, `全功能支持`, a bare UUID). Modelling them as a semver pattern would have made 32 ordinary rows look like schema drift, so the manifest models the *value* shape and treats the key as opaque.

community-plugins-removed.json.role: Removal List — historical annotations, never a membership authority

id.target: join key for attaching a removal reason to a deletion in the Run Report

name.rationale: The name at removal time is not an identity the catalog uses; deletions are keyed by id, and the note being deleted already carries its own name.

reason.target: deletion reason recorded in the Run Report (decision 3.3)

issue.rationale: A link to the upstream removal discussion. Not rendered into any note; the Run Report carries the reason text, and the mirror keeps the link.

community-css-themes-removed.json.role: Removal List for themes — annotations only; removed themes carry no repo key

name.target: join key (name → slug) for attaching a removal reason in the Run Report

reason.target: deletion reason recorded in the Run Report

issue.rationale: As for plugins: the upstream discussion link is not rendered.

community-plugin-deprecation.json.role: Deprecation List — plugin id to deprecated versions

wholeFile.rationale: Out of catalog scope by decision (§1 Glossary, §10). The catalog carries no version information at all, so a deprecated-version map has nothing to map onto.
wholeFile.keyShape: plugin id → array of version strings

consumedInputs.consumer: plugin and theme body tasks; also recorded verbatim as the data block `about` field when present
repository body task; interim theme body fallback while §11.1 is open

ignoredEvents.rationale: Per-version download counters appear and change on every release; per-version series are out of scope (§10).
A Removal List `reason` or `issue` arriving after the note is already deleted has nothing to annotate; history stays in the mirror (§6.3.3).
